product_one_liner.value: Harmony Healthcare IT provides healthcare data-management software and services for hospitals and other healthcare organizations to extract, migrate, preserve, and access records from legacy clinical and business systems.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its solutions as spanning data extraction, migration/conversion, and archiving.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage provides consultation/contact calls to action and no public pricing page or prices.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in Harmony Healthcare IT case-study material.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company lists its headquarters in South Bend, Indiana.

founded_year.notes: The company says it was founded in 2006.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains informational, security, data-management, and product-related posts, but it does not show at least two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built (such as architecture, infrastructure, ML implementation, incidents, or open source).

public_docs.notes: The public support page links to product-specific support portals and resources for multiple products, rather than only a single FAQ.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The currently listed openings include engineering, analyst, and business-development roles; none has AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision in its title.

model_provider.notes: The company’s public product/support information, blog, security material, and accessible Trust Center search did not identify an AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The company labels itself HIPAA Compliant. It also states that it holds HITRUST certification, which is outside the requested list; its SOC 2 wording refers to Type II facilities, not a company SOC 2 certification. No ISO 27001, GDPR, or PCI DSS certification claim was identified.

last_funding.notes: The latest located round was a Novacap private-equity investment announced in November 2023, but the amount was not disclosed. The required numeric amount field is set to 0 as a placeholder, not as a claim that the investment was zero.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest located funding round was announced in November 2023, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Openings include Business Development Director and Associate Business Development Director roles, but none is titled SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable announcements index does not show a product or major feature launch during 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09. The latest located launch-type announcement was the digital/brand launch dated June 24, 2025, before the window; other recent indexed items concern company news, partnerships, or recognition.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Harmony announced Brian Liddell’s appointment as CEO effective April 30, 2026, within the 12-month window; founder Tom Liddell transitioned to Chairman.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public support/product-system resources and visible job listings reviewed did not name a CRM or sales/marketing automation platform. The systems named in support resources are healthcare/EHR systems, not CRM products.
